operations: Look up a user by ID or UPN
Assign or remove licenses and roles

mutate.title: Randomize an attribute
mutate.description: Picks one attribute at random (from the set {{attributes}}) and overwrites it with a random value on every identity listed above (when Identities is enabled).

mail.title: Mail
operations: Send a new mail message as a mailbox

mutate.title: Randomize mailbox activity
mutate.description: For each selected mailbox, performs one random action: send a new message ({{send}}%), reply to an existing message (35%), forward one message to another randomly-selected user (30%){{deletions}}. Random subject and body text come from OpenRouter when a key is configured, otherwise they're a simple GUID.
mutate.deletionsClause: , or move one to Deleted Items (5%)

size.title: Message size
size.description: Make new messages larger to grow mailbox storage. Microsoft supports auto-expanding archives only for mailboxes that grow by no more than 1 GB per day, so keep the daily cap at 1 GB or less for that scenario. Sizes are estimates.
size.bodyKbHint: 0 keeps the short default text. Replies use this size too.
size.attachmentMbHint: Random data on each new message. 0 means none. Max 25.
size.dailyCapGbHint: Stops the run at this much growth today. 0 means no cap.
size.today: Added today: about {{used}} GB of {{cap}} GB.
size.added: This run added about {{added}} GB. Today's total is about {{today}} GB.

job.progress: {{completed}} of {{planned}} actions · {{ok}} ok · {{failed}} failed · about {{added}} GB added
job.leaveHint: The run continues on the server if you leave this page. Come back any time to check on it.
job.alreadyRunning: A mail run is already in progress.
job.recentNote: Showing the most recent {{shown}} of {{total}} actions.
job.continuousHint: Runs until you stop it. With a daily cap, it pauses at the cap and resumes after midnight; set the cap to 0 to run without pausing. It ends on its own after 25 failures in a row, for example when the mailbox is full.
job.progressContinuous: {{completed}} actions · {{ok}} ok · {{failed}} failed · about {{added}} GB added · running for {{elapsed}}
job.throttledNow: Outlook is throttling this mailbox right now ({{count}} times in the last 5 minutes). The run slows down and retries automatically.
job.throttleSummary: Throttled {{events}} times ({{tooMany}}× 429, {{busy}}× 503/504), about {{wait}} of waiting in total. Last at {{time}}.
job.summaryContinuous: Continuous run: {{total}} actions · {{ok}} ok · {{failed}} failed · ran for {{elapsed}}
job.failuresNote: Ended after 25 failures in a row. Last error: {{error}}
job.toastFailures: Mail run ended after 25 failures in a row

calendar.title: Calendar
operations: Create a calendar event with attendees

mutate.title: Randomize calendar activity
mutate.description: For each selected mailbox, performs one random action: create a meeting request inviting another selected user (50%) or create a single-user appointment (50%). Each is a 30-minute event on a weekday within the sender's working hours, with a random subject from OpenRouter when a key is configured.
